title: DILR Section Test 1 · 2026
description: 22 DILR questions across five intact sets. Transcribed from your IMS images, with supplied question benchmarks.

groups.title: Football tournament starting points

questions.prompt: The same points given to four teams in the beginning were ______.
What were the highest points awarded to any team in the beginning of the tournament?
Which team had the highest points at the end of the first round?
If no two teams with the same starting points played against each other on any of the four days, which of the following cannot be the number of points of any team at the end of day 4?
Which of the following can be the minimum value of the points of any team at the end of Day 4?

groups.stimulus:
Eight teams A, B, C, D, E, F,G and H participated in an annual national level football tournament. Each team was awarded some starting points (positive integer values) at the beginning of the tournament based on their performances in the last year’s tournament. The starting points of exactly four of the eight teams were equal while the remaining four teams had distinct starting points. No team had fewer starting points than team A.

The first round of this tournament was to be played over four days with one match everyday. There was no tie in the first round. Points update after each match and carry forward to the next day: if a team with W points defeats a team with L points, then the winner’s new points become W+L (i.e. the winner gains the loser’s pre-match points), and the loser’s new points become L-1. (Points may become 0.) Following points are known:

1. On the first day A and C played against each other. Compared to just before this match, at the end of the match the average points of all eight teams increased by 0.25.

2. On the second day E and F played against each other. Compared to just before this match, at the end of the match the average points of all eight teams again increased by 0.25.

3. On the third day G and H played against each other. After this the average points of all the eight teams increased by 0.5 and became 4.5.

4. On the fourth day B and D played against each other.

groups.title: Spanish game scores

questions.prompt: If Emram's score in Round Uno was equal to Dikram's score in Round Quatre, then what was Fimram's score in round Cinco?
Referring to the previous question, who scored the least points and in which round?
Referring to the previous question, what is the difference between the highest scorer and the least scorer?
Referring to previous question, what is Akram's score in round Quatre?

groups.stimulus:
The table below gives the points scored by six friends Akram, Bikram, Chakram, Dikram, Emram and Fimram in five rounds of a Spanish game. U, D, T, Q and C denote the minimum points obtained by the six students in the five rounds i.e. Rounds Uno, Dos, Tres, Quatre and Cinco (One, Two, Three, Four and Five translated in Spanish) respectively. No one scored less than 50 in any round. The sum of all the points scored by all the friends in all the rounds was 2170.

Rounds: Uno | Dos | Tres | Quatre | Cinco
Akram: U+31 | D | T+13 | Q+4 | C+19
Bikram: U+24 | D+9 | T | Q+7 | C+29
Chakram: U+19 | D+15 | T+8 | Q | C+34
Dikram: U+32 | D+27 | T+36 | Q+26 | C
Emram: U+26 | D+12 | T+33 | Q+18 | C+21
Fimram: U | D+8 | T+9 | Q | C+24

- Chakram's points in Round Dos was 3 marks less than Emram's marks in Round Quatre.

- Akram's points in Round Uno and Dikram's points in Round Tres were equal.

- Fimram's points in Round Cinco and Chakram's points in Round Dos were equal.

groups.title: Hockey tournament

questions.prompt: Out of all the matches played in the tournament, results of how many matches can be uniquely determined?
By what margin of goals did India beat Canada?
Which match ended in a zero draw?
Which of the following statements is incorrect?

options.text: The two teams that Australia beat with a margin of 6 goals were Spain and India.
India failed to score a single goal against total 3 teams.
Australia scored odd number of goals against Canada.
Australia beat Canada by a margin of 2 goals.

groups.stimulus:
A hockey tournament was played involving Australia, Germany, Poland, Spain, India and Canada at Hannover, Germany. In the tournament, each team played against every other team exactly once. Each match lasted for 90 minutes and the team that scored more goals than the other team was declared the winner while the team that scored fewer goals than the other team lost the match. If both teams scored equal number of goals, the match was said to be drawn. A team was awarded 2 points for every match won, 1 point for every match drawn and 0 points for every match lost. At the end of the tournament, the points table was as follows:

Team | Played | Won | Drawn | Lost | Goals scored | Goals conceded
Australia | 5 | 4 | 1 | 0 | 23 | 6
Germany | 5 | 2 | 3 | 0 | 9 | 4
Poland | 5 | 2 | 1 | 2 | 8 | 9
Spain | 5 | 2 | 1 | 2 | 7 | 13
India | 5 | 1 | 1 | 3 | 5 | 10
Canada | 5 | 0 | 1 | 4 | 3 | 13

Further following information is known:

1. Only one match ended in zero-draw (situation in which both teams fail to score a single goal).

2. Canada failed to score a single goal against Poland and India.

3. Australia scored 2 goals against Germany and beat two other teams by the margin of 6 goals each.

4. Germany scored 3 goals against Poland and 2 goals against Canada. Both Poland and Canada failed to score a single goal against Germany.

5. India failed to score a single goal against Poland and Australia.

6. Poland scored 2 goals against Australia and 5 goals against Spain.

7. Spain scored 2 goals against India and 3 goals against Canada but failed to score a single goal against Australia.

groups.title: Citibank campus placements

questions.prompt: If Amit is the fifth who got an offer from Citibank, then he is from:
Neha is from:
If Amit is the 5th person who got an offer from Citibank , how many students from Amit's institute got an offer from Citibank?
Sandy is from:
If Amit is the 5th student who got an offer, the institutes of how many of the 5 students can be uniquely determined?

groups.stimulus: The most prized company to come for campus placements this year at IIMA, IIMB and IIMC was Citibank. With a whopping pay package of $225000 per annum, it selected five students from the three IIMs. Rohit who was not from IIMC was given an offer. Two IIMA students got the offers while only one IIMC student got the offer. Sandy and Neha both were not from IIMA while Neha and Ashita were from the same institute.

groups.title: Coloured boxes and balls

questions.prompt: If the red ball is in the box to the left of the box containing the black ball, which coloured box contains the pair of trousers?
If the pink ball is to the immediate right of the black ball, in which coloured box is the pair of trousers?
If the jacket is in the blue coloured box, what coloured ball is in the box containing the handkerchief?
The cap is in the ______ coloured box

groups.stimulus: Six boxes coloured red, green, yellow, pink, blue and black are placed in a row from left to right in that order. Each box contains a ball and one of the following things: a handkerchief, a shirt, a pair of trousers, a T-Shirt, a jacket and a cap. There is exactly one ball of each of the six colours: red, green, yellow, pink, blue and black. For any colour, the ball bearing that colour is not in the box bearing the same colour and also, not in either box adjacent to the box bearing the same colour. The green ball is not in the black box. The blue and green balls are equidistant from the ends. The shirt is in the box that contains the red ball. The trousers are in the box that contains the black ball. The T-Shirt is not in the box containing the green ball or in the box containing the yellow ball. The cap is in the box containing the blue ball.
